title: Luxury East Loft | Mins to Broadway | Free Parking
description:
Beautiful 3-story townhome located in East Nashville, built in 2020. Just a 7-minute Uber ride to Broadway!

The first floor features an open living area and kitchen. 

The second floor includes a full bathroom with a large tiled standing glass shower and a queen-sized bed. 

The third floor features a twin trundle-style bed to accommodate two additional guests, along with access to a rooftop patio!

The home also includes in-unit laundry and totals 985 sq. ft.

The space
Modern 3-story townhome, just 5 years old, located in vibrant East Nashville. 

The first floor features an open-concept living area and kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances, custom quartz countertops, and a sleek glass subway tile backsplash.

The second floor includes a spacious bathroom with a large tiled standing glass shower and a queen-sized Tempur-Pedic Bed. 

The third floor features a twin sized trundle-style bed to accommodate two additional guests, along with access to a rooftop patio.

Washer and dryer are included in the home for your convenience.

Guest access
The entire home can be used for guests.

Other things to note
Free on-site parking available in a secure, gated neighborhood.
